stem: How many days do you have to notify the EAA of a change in your registered agency address?
explanation: Under section 40 of Cap. 511, a licensee must notify the Authority in writing within 31 days of any change of registered address.

stem: When must an Ad Valorem Stamp Duty (AVD) generally be paid for a residential property transaction?
option_a: Within 14 days after signing the PASP
option_b: Within 30 days after signing the PASP
option_d: Within 30 days after signing the Formal Agreement
explanation: The Stamp Duty Ordinance requires AVD on residential properties to be paid within 30 days after the execution of the chargeable agreement (usually the PASP).

stem: According to the EAA Code of Ethics
option_a: when must an agent disclose to a client that they have a personal interest in the property?
option_b: Before the client views the property
option_c: Before the signing of any agreement
ordinance_tag: Agents must fully disclose any conflict of interest to their clients before any agreement is signed to ensure fairness.
